title: Boomerang page plan, March 5 | | wyomingnews.com
text:
BOOMERANG page plan for THURSDAY, March 5
A1 (send color)
- Main story (play this up): EPA Region 8 administrator visits UW to discuss environmental law and careers, Rachel (photo/mug for front)
- Down one side (2½ columns for photo below text): Commissioners finalize county solar project, approve final contractor payment, Rachel (also logo)
- Across bottom: House passes literacy bill on 3rd reading, sends back to Senate, WTE (photo/Leg.-logo for front; three mugs)
- Jumps to A3 and A5 if needed
A2 (send color)
- What’s Happening
- Today/tomorrow/history
- Worth noting briefs (three)
- Correction policy
- Weather graphic
A3 (send color)
Legislature fails to conform Wyoming law to court’s OK of corner crossing, WyoFile (photo/Leg.-logo/pull text)
A1 jumps
A4 (send color) - jumps to A5
Syndicated cartoon
Madeline Dalrymple and others column (Local/other voices) – unbold all names in tagline
Powell Tribune (Wyoming editorial)
Dave Marston (Other voices)
Letters to the editor policies – if room
A5 (send color)
Obits (one notice)
Around Wyoming briefs
A1/A4 jumps
Vol. 146, No. 54
A6 (send color) OUTDOORS (PAGE SPLIT – 3/4 for Amber; 1/4 for bottom stories) – jumps to A7
MAIN (Top 3/4 of page – play this up): Going to where there’s snow - Chimney Park ski trails are the hot spot, Travsky (four photos/mug/for front; fifth photo for jump if room)
BOTTOM 1/4: Wyoming just had its warmest winter ever, surpassing Dust Bowl records, WyoFile (photo/pull text for front; second photo for jump)
A7 (send color)
Jumps from A6
Sponsorship strip ad
Snow report PDF
A8 (send color)
UW planetarium to host spring equinox program during March, staff (photo/logo)
------------------------------------------------
